output.reason: [ev-ad50caeacfe2] says all Argo CD container images are signed by cosign and come with SLSA Level 3 provenance. This is a property of the published release artifacts and does not affect how a running environment behaves. The environments that touch this subject are the ones that run the Argo CD image. The validator confirmed that quay.io/argoproj/argocd is referenced in both the v2.14.5 and v3.0.0 install manifests [ev-6ea7d1aa2ac2, ev-b9fde9c8ce58], so image-in-use on that repository is a fair exposure condition for a consequence of "none". Confidence is low for two reasons: the text does not say that signing is new in 3.0.0, and the provenance also covers CLI binaries, which no in-cluster condition can capture.
